def overlap_minutes(meetings: list[list[int]], k: int) -> int:
    starts = sorted(s for s, e in meetings if s < e)
    ends = sorted(e for s, e in meetings if s < e)
    n = len(starts)

    i = 0
    j = 0
    active = 0
    prev = 0
    total = 0

    while i < n:
        if starts[i] < ends[j]:
            cur = starts[i]
            if active >= k:
                total += cur - prev
            active += 1
            prev = cur
            i += 1
        elif ends[j] < starts[i]:
            cur = ends[j]
            if active >= k:
                total += cur - prev
            active -= 1
            prev = cur
            j += 1
        else:
            cur = starts[i]
            if active >= k:
                total += cur - prev
            prev = cur
            i += 1
            j += 1

    while j < n:
        cur = ends[j]
        if active >= k:
            total += cur - prev
        active -= 1
        prev = cur
        j += 1

    return total
